raw: I remember a time when my canoe overturned far from shore. There was a sudden gust from behind, and I remember seeing one of the paddles drifting out of reach. That really frightened me—the shore was so far away, and now the canoe was overturned and the paddle was getting away. I was thinking about how I was going to get back to shore. It felt very different being that far out once the canoe had tipped over.
